description: Wire github_pr_checker.py webhook endpoint into the pipeline. Must: (1) receive GitHub PR webhook on port 8780 or 8790, (2) query mcp_server_registry for MCP names in PR description, (3) fetch verdict for each referenced MCP via write_service :8772/query, (4) POST check run result to GitHub API with verdict. MUST NOT auto-approve HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED or KNOWN_THREAT MCPs. Must use X-API-Key auth for GitHub API calls. Reference: github_pr_checker.py (already built).
